global_settings.label: Dollar Rate - Prestretch (EGP per USD)
global_settings.help: 'Material pricing' F2. Used for pre-stretch film core costing.

global_settings.label: Capacity Usage % (machine utilization)
global_settings.help: 'Conversion cost' I2 / 'تكاليف ثابتة' L1. Assumed factory utilization used to convert daily tons capacity into monthly production tons for spreading fixed and variable overhead.

global_settings.label: Material interest rate (fraction)
global_settings.help: 'تكاليف متغيرة' D5 = ((3.216%+5.35%)/4)*(1-22.5%). Interest cost on resin purchased on credit; applied to the sum of material composition costs. NOTE: the source workbook currently has this line disabled for the month (a neighbouring cell's note: removed this month due to how the material-interest file is being managed, covered instead by credit interest), i.e. effectively 0 in the live workbook. Stored here as an editable rate defaulting to the computed 1.66% so it can be turned back on by an admin; set to 0 to match the current live workbook behaviour.

global_settings.label: Material waste factor
global_settings.help: Stretch sheet material-cost formulas multiply by 1.01 (waste allowance).

global_settings.label: Material scrap/handling factor
global_settings.help: Stretch sheet material-cost formulas multiply by 1.04 (handling/scrap allowance).
